items.title: Moderna Climbs 5% Ahead of Earnings, Pfizer Eases Despite Raised Outlook, Merck Slides 2% Amid New Phase 3 Trial
items.summary: Moderna surges on pre-earnings momentum, Pfizer dips after beating estimates and raising guidance, and Merck drops despite launching a new trial. When stock prices and headlines point in opposite directions across the sector, something beneath the surface deserves a closer look.

items.title: Raised Guidance Altering The Investment Case For Eli Lilly Stock?
items.summary: Eli Lilly reported Q3 2026 sales of US$24.4b and net income of US$6.5b, raised full-year revenue guidance to a range of US$91b to US$92b, and released clinical data across obesity, diabetes, and oncology programs. Beyond headline incretin demand, Lilly is tying higher revenue guidance to heavy manufacturing investment, AI-supported Alzheimer’s research through the SpeechDx license, and a broad late-stage oncology pipeline. We will look at how Eli Lilly's 2026 revenue guidance, supported by...

items.title: Merck’s Pipeline Could Be Its Next Big Growth Driver. Its Latest Earnings Offer a Clue.
items.summary: Merck just posted its sixth straight earnings beat and its CEO is targeting $70 billion in mid-2030s revenue, yet the stock carries a looming patent cliff that could reshape everything. Whether the pipeline saves the story or the bears win depends on one upcoming FDA decision.

items.title: Forget Nvidia: Eli Lilly Will Become “the Most Valuable Company in the World,” Says Macro Investor
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEli Lilly hit a record high on Friday after raising its 2026 revenue forecast to $91-$92 billion, lifting its market value to about $1. 1 trillion, level with Berkshire Hathaway.
